mapper.sql: SELECT g.id, g.athlete_id, g.dept_id, g.join_date, g.leave_date, g.status, g.create_by, g.create_time, d.dept_name, CASE d.dept_type WHEN '30' THEN '训练小组' WHEN '40' THEN '科研小组' WHEN '50' THEN '恢复小组' ELSE '其他' END AS dept_type_name FROM apms_athlete_group g LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON g.dept_id = d.dept_id
mapper.select: WHERE g.athlete_id = #{athleteId} ORDER BY g.join_date DESC, g.id DESC
WHERE g.athlete_id = #{athleteId} AND g.leave_date IS NULL AND g.status = '0' LIMIT 1
WHERE g.dept_id = #{deptId} AND g.leave_date IS NULL AND g.status = '0' ORDER BY g.join_date DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE apms_athlete_group SET leave_date = #{leaveDate}, status = '1' WHERE athlete_id = #{athleteId} AND leave_date IS NULL AND status = '0'
